title: Edmund and the Debt
author: Q. M. Nystrom
blurb: Beatrix Yarrow, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
